territories.name: Chile
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Chile levies a value added tax of its own under Decreto Ley N° 825, de 1974, whose article 14 sets the general rate at 19 %.
